answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable bond before earning, and tie reputation to one verifiable signal: a ferrous-hardware attestation proving one device per identity. A sybil operator crossing that canyon of cost must buy a separate locked device and bond for each fake, so forging a thousand identities costs a thousand bonds plus hardware, while honest agents pay once and keep working. Auditors slash bonds on proven duplicates, turning scale itself into the attacker's expense.
